name: Engineering Party A profile master
type: AM Platform / contracts / reusable contracting parties
scope: Add a Party A master page for company and individual profiles
Keep company large seals and individual signatures in private Drive storage
Copy the selected Party A into each immutable contract version
Render the selected Party A signing assets only in the final confirmed PDF

dataIsolation.guard: Real Party A records and signing images remain in the Engineering dedicated PostgreSQL and private Drive boundary.

definitionOfDone: Contract managers can create, edit, and archive company or individual Party A profiles
Company profiles require a large seal and individual profiles require a signature
Selecting a profile fills Party A legal fields and stores a version snapshot
Profile edits do not change prior version snapshots
Final PDF rendering verifies private asset hashes before applying Party A signing images
